title: The Bell That Broke
logline: A town that stopped ringing its bell must decide whether the silence was mercy or cowardice.

reference.source: Ejemplos/Video/The Ancient Jar That Warned an Empire [VS1Z_Q-Klt8].mp4
reference.borrowed: shot rhythm, vertical framing, painted 2D look, burned-in captions

shots.line: the winter the river stopped, the bell stopped with it
shots.note: establishing: two figures cross the square toward the bell, camera pans with them

shots.line: nine days, the keeper said, and nobody rings it but me
shots.note: threshold shot: warm interior against cold snow, the keeper blocks the door

shots.line: he had rung it once before. it did not end well.
shots.note: realisation: push-in on the keeper's face, no camera trick beyond the move

shots.line: so the apprentice dug, and the ground rang instead
shots.note: the action beat: real digging motion, sun behind, long shadows

shots.line: and the bell, at last, answered.
shots.note: insert: the object that resolves the story, dust in the light, no zoom-as-animation
